ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Pinkberry uses your location to find your delivery address and, if you are a rider, to let the customer track their order live.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Riders: Pinkberry shares your location during an ongoing delivery, even when the screen is locked, so the customer can track their order. Sharing stops as soon as the delivery is complete.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pinkberry accesses your photos only to add product and banner images to the menu (admin area).
